_about: J. M. Barrie's (1860-1937) books published before 1930: the Peter Pan books (the novel Peter and Wendy, Peter Pan in Kensington Gardens, the earlier Little White Bird they grew from, and the play as printed in 1928), the Thrums books, the Tommy novels, the plays, sketches and addresses. Clean Gutenberg text; all published before 1930: US public domain. Barrie died in 1937, so life+70 and life+80 countries differ, and the UK gives Great Ormond Street Hospital a perpetual right to royalties on Peter Pan performances and publications; this shelf records US status only.

barrie-peter-and-wendy: Peter and Wendy (1911), the Peter Pan novel
barrie-peter-pan-play: Peter Pan; or, The Boy Who Would Not Grow Up (play, first printed New York 1928)
barrie-little-white-bird: The Little White Bird; or, Adventures in Kensington Gardens (1902)
barrie-holiday-in-bed: A Holiday in Bed, and Other Sketches (1892)
barrie-der-tag: Der Tag; or, The Tragic Man (play, 1914)
barrie-neither-dorking-nor-the-abbey: Neither Dorking nor the Abbey (1911), on George Meredith
